title: Adsorption of Indigo Carmine onto Zn–Cu–Fe layered triple hydroxides and oxides: a comparative investigation of removal mechanisms and matrix effects
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30124-30144
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03446B, Paper

Mohamed Farag, Sami A. Al-Hussain, Arafat Toghan, Emad M. Masoud, Ashraf A. Mohamed, Mohamed A. Ahmed, Hoda A. Ahmed, Mahmoud A. Ahmed
Layered triple hydroxides and their calcined oxides offer distinct adsorption pathways for anionic pollutants, yet how thermal transformation redirects these mechanisms, particularly for bulky dye molecules, remains poorly understood.
